name: Lecture
description: A single lecture in Dr. Gila Gavrielov's 'Diagnosis & Healing with Crystals' course. Holds bilingual (Hebrew/English) metadata and a provider-agnostic video source per language.

order.description: Lecture number within the course, used for ordering.

code.description: Source step code, e.g. P1L05 (Part 1, Lesson 5).

part.description: Course part/section this lecture belongs to (1 = Part 1).

video_he_source.description: Hebrew video source: YouTube id, Mux playback id, Vimeo id, or direct URL.

video_en_source.description: English (translated) video source. Empty until the HeyGen translation is published.

translation_status.description: State of the English translation for this lecture.

free_preview.description: If true, playable by anyone (no enrollment required).

is_published.description: If false, hidden from the public catalog (draft).
